reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it presents its own branded Bitcoin trading program as offering daily compounded growth after joining a trading pool with at least $100 of Bitcoin. It promotes a 10 percent referral bonus and a weekly binary bonus tied to introducing people into two positions and maintaining at least $200, with bonuses shown as withdrawable or reinvestable wallet funds. The dashboard and slides show related BTC wallet-transfer and pending-bonus workflows, although the available video evidence does not establish that any transfer, trading activity, or payout was completed.

citations.quote: You join the trading pool with a minimum of $100 of Bitcoin.
The next stream of income from Mirotit Trading International is the referral bonus.
you will be compounding daily
personally introduced one person on the left
This will qualify you for the binary bonus and you will receive a weekly binary bonus for your smallest leg.

opening.argument: The presentation itself qualifies how to read the displayed value: “The US Dollar value is just an indication and will fluctuate with the bitcoin price.” It also explains that statement units require conversion rather than inviting viewers to treat the displayed figure as cash: “1 bits equals 0.0000001 BTC.” Those qualifications make the dashboard a description of how the platform presents balances, not proof of a fixed dollar return or completed payout. The supplied material does not establish that trading occurred or that any return was guaranteed.

citations.quote: The US Dollar value is just an indication and will fluctuate with the bitcoin price.
Please note that 1 bits equals 0.0000001 BTC.
To get the Bitcoin value, divide your balance by 1 million.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening treats compounding language and the minimum pool amount as evidence of an established investment offer, but the video describes a platform process and its displayed accounting; it does not establish that funds were transferred or that the described trading took place. Its qualification that the dollar figure fluctuates also cuts against reading the display as a promised fixed dollar outcome.

citations.quote: The US Dollar value is just an indication and will fluctuate with the bitcoin price.
you can simply click view detailed reports

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A fluctuating dollar indication is not a warning that the advertised Bitcoin growth may fail. The speaker still says viewers join a trading pool and that Bitcoin is compounded daily; describing how to convert displayed units does not make those earnings independently verified or merely hypothetical.

you will be compounding daily

opening.argument: This is structured as an operational walkthrough of a platform back office: the speaker directs viewers to reports, explains what the balance fields mean, and clarifies the unit conversion. For example, “To view your daily trading results, you can simply click view detailed reports” and “1 bits equals 0.0000001 BTC.” The focus is on navigating and interpreting an interface, not evidence that a viewer completed a transaction or received a payout. Describing the platform’s stated features does not, by itself, verify those claims.

citations.quote: Let's look at your back office dashboard.
To view your daily trading results, you can simply click view detailed reports
Please note that 1 bits equals 0.0000001 BTC.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The video does discuss bonuses, but the reference opening does not show that its interface tutorial resulted in any trading or payout. Its cited statements describe joining and bonus qualifications; they do not establish that a completed transfer occurred. The presentation’s report-navigation instructions are concrete operational content, not just a bare promise.

citations.quote: you can simply click view detailed reports
This is the current available bonuses which includes the pending bonuses.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The walkthrough is not neutral instruction about an unrelated tool: it presents the named platform’s income streams, explains how to join its trading pool, and describes compounding as an expected benefit. Showing viewers where to find bonus reports makes the promotional claims actionable, even though it cannot prove a payout occurred.

citations.quote: You join the trading pool with a minimum of $100 of Bitcoin.
The next stream of income from Mirotit Trading International is the referral bonus.
you will be compounding daily

opening.argument: The video describes several types of platform bonuses and their account handling, including referral credits with a waiting period and an option to withdraw or reinvest once released. That can be read as an explanation of a referral-promotion and rewards structure, rather than proof of a completed investment or payout. Crucially, the video evidence does not establish that any transfer, trading activity, or payout was completed, and the material does not say what a referred person must do for a referral bonus to be earned. A displayed workflow is not proof of a realized benefit.

citations.quote: When these are released into your wallet you can either withdraw or reinvest into your trading pool.
The waiting period for the Binary Bonuses, just like the referral commissions, is 7 days.
The next stream of income from Mirotit Trading International is the referral bonus.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening infers an investment-pool mechanism from the description of a minimum Bitcoin contribution and daily compounding, but the supplied evidence does not confirm trading or completed returns. The weekly bonus qualification it cites describes a stated rule; it does not establish that anyone recruited, deposited, or received money. The video also explains a seven-day waiting period for bonuses rather than depicting an immediate completed payout.

citations.quote: The waiting period for the Binary Bonuses, just like the referral commissions, is 7 days
When these are released into your wallet you can either withdraw or reinvest into your trading pool.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Calling these amounts ordinary rewards omits that the central bonus is tied to Bitcoin in a trading pool with daily compounding, while the binary bonus requires introducing people on two sides and maintaining a personal position. A waiting period or an uncompleted transfer does not change the economic mechanism the video promotes.
